description: This header file declares functions and structures related to managing and maintaining a topology tree for a controller in a networking environment. It includes initialization, updates, retries, cleanup, and queries related to topology management.

methods.name: map_ctrl_topology_tree_init
methods.description: Initializes the controller's topology tree data structures.

methods.name: map_add_as_child_of_controller
methods.description: Adds a specified ALE as a child of the controller in the topology tree.

methods.name: map_build_topology_tree
methods.description: Builds a topology tree from a list of neighbor TLVs.

methods.name: map_register_topology_query_retry
methods.description: Registers a retry timer to send topology queries until a response is received.

methods.name: map_register_delayed_topology_query_retry
methods.description: Registers a delayed retry timer to send topology queries.

methods.name: map_cleanup_agent
methods.description: Removes a dead agent and cleans up related resources.

methods.name: map_extend_ale_deletion
methods.description: Restarts the retry handler to extend the deletion process of an ALE.

methods.name: map_is_topology_update_required
methods.description: Determines if a topology update is needed based on the last response timestamp.

methods.name: map_get_local_agent_ale
methods.description: Retrieves the local agent's ALE information.

methods.name: map_is_local_agent
methods.description: Checks if a given ALE is the local agent.

methods.name: map_is_controller
methods.description: Checks if a given ALE is the controller.
